Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 19 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 678 impostors cost 1677 times the honest price and take 2 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
